'''Moema Isabel Passos Gramacho''' ([[Salvador, Bahia|Salvador]], July 4, 1958), better known as '''Moema Gramacho''', is a Brazilian [[biologist]], [[chemist]], and [[politician]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Dep. Moema Gramacho |url=http://www.al.ba.gov.br/deputados/Deputados-Interna.php?id=36 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160920035250/http://www.al.ba.gov.br/deputados/Deputados-Interna.php?id=36 |archive-date=2016-09-20 |access-date=2025-11-27 |website=www.al.ba.gov.br |language=Pt-br}}</ref> She is affiliated with the [[Workers' Party (Brazil)|Workers' Party]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Deputada MOEMA GRAMACHO - Câmara dos Deputados |url=http://www.camara.leg.br/internet/deputado/dep_Detalhe.asp?id=5830663 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160424042249/http://www.camara.leg.br/internet/deputado/dep_Detalhe.asp?id=5830663 |archive-date=2016-04-24 |access-date=2025-12-09 |website=www.camara.leg.br |language=pt-br}}</ref> She served as mayor of [[Lauro de Freitas]] for four terms and as a [[Legislative Assembly of Bahia|State]] and [[Federal deputy|Federal Deputy]] for [[Bahia]].

== Political career ==
She was a [[city councilor]] in Salvador in 1997, an alternate [[state deputy]] between 1995 and 1999 and made a full-fledged deputy in January 1997, elected state deputy in 1998, re-elected in 2002 and resigned on December 30, 2004.<ref name=":0" />

She served as [[mayor]] of [[Lauro de Freitas]] from 2005 to 2012, having received several awards as an entrepreneurial mayor (for the creation of the Municipal Program for Accelerating Work, Employment and Income)<ref>{{Cite web |title=ASN - Município de Lauro de Freitas, na Bahia, leva o Prêmio Prefeito Empreendedor |url=http://www.ba.agenciasebrae.com.br/sites/asn/uf/BA/municipio-de-lauro-de-freitas-na-bahia-leva-o-premio-prefeito-empreendedor,da07e3e93e626410VgnVCM1000003b74010aRCRD |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180318120442/http://www.ba.agenciasebrae.com.br/sites/asn/uf/BA/municipio-de-lauro-de-freitas-na-bahia-leva-o-premio-prefeito-empreendedor,da07e3e93e626410VgnVCM1000003b74010aRCRD |archive-date=2018-03-18 |access-date=2025-12-09 |website=www.ba.agenciasebrae.com.br |language=pt-br}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Moema Gramacho foi a grande vencedora do Prêmio Prefeito Empreendedor.|url=https://www.salobro.com/2010/04/moema-gramacho-foi-grande-vencedora-do.html|access-date=2025-11-28|website=Salobro Bahia|language=Pt-br}}</ref> and “best mayor in the Americas” by the Organização Brasil Américas.<ref name=":1" /> She established the first [[sickle cell disease]] reference center in Bahia<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lauro de Freitas inagura o Primeiro Centro de Assistência à Doença Falciforme|url=http://bahia.ig.com.br/2010/11/11/lauro-de-freitas-inagura-o-primeiro-centro-de-assistencia-a-doenca-falciforme|website=IG|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180318182623/http://bahia.ig.com.br/2010/11/11/lauro-de-freitas-inagura-o-primeiro-centro-de-assistencia-a-doenca-falciforme|archive-date=2018-03-18|language=Pt-br}}</ref> and inaugurated the first public [[maternity hospital]] in Lauro de Freitas,<ref>{{Cite news |last=Total |first=Rinha Comunicação |title=Governo inaugura Maternidade em Lauro de Freitas |url=http://varelanoticias.com.br/governo-inaugura-maternidade-em-lauro-de-freitas/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121016060033/http://varelanoticias.com.br/governo-inaugura-maternidade-em-lauro-de-freitas/ |archive-date=2012-10-16 |access-date=2025-12-09 |work=Varela Notícias |language=pt-BR}}</ref> which was closed the following year during her successor's term.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Maternidade é fechada após um ano; contratos perderam validade |url=http://www.correio24horas.com.br/detalhe/bahia/noticia/maternidade-e-fechada-apos-um-ano-contratos-perderam-validade/?cHash=e67003033b042fa1a360784b1bcab06b |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161024215453/http://www.correio24horas.com.br/detalhe/bahia/noticia/maternidade-e-fechada-apos-um-ano-contratos-perderam-validade/?cHash=e67003033b042fa1a360784b1bcab06b |archive-date=2016-10-24 |access-date=2025-12-09 |work=Correio 24 Horas |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

In 2013 she assumed the State Secretariat for Social Development and Poverty Alleviation.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2013-04-08 |title=Moema Gramacho é nomeada secretária estadual, anuncia governo |url=http://g1.globo.com/bahia/noticia/2013/04/moema-gramacho-e-nomeada-secretaria-estadual-anuncia-governo.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180319004101/http://g1.globo.com/bahia/noticia/2013/04/moema-gramacho-e-nomeada-secretaria-estadual-anuncia-governo.html |archive-date=2018-03-19 |access-date=2025-12-09 |work=[[G1 (website)|G1]] |language=pt-BR}}</ref> In 2014, she was elected [[federal deputy]].<ref name=":1" /> In 2016 she was elected mayor of Lauro de Freitas again, with 52.34% of the valid votes.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Moema Gramacho é eleita e volta à prefeitura de Lauro de Freitas |url=http://www.correio24horas.com.br/detalhe/categoria/noticia/moema-gramacho-e-eleita-e-volta-a-prefeitura-de-lauro-de-freitas/?cHash=6db757d1e0bd0291f54c597bf25da83a |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161004154610/http://www.correio24horas.com.br/detalhe/categoria/noticia/moema-gramacho-e-eleita-e-volta-a-prefeitura-de-lauro-de-freitas/?cHash=6db757d1e0bd0291f54c597bf25da83a |archive-date=2016-10-04 |access-date=2025-12-09 |work=Correio 24 Horas |language=pt-BR}}</ref> In 2020 she was elected mayor of Lauro de Freitas for the fourth time.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Moema Gramacho, do PT, é reeleita prefeita de Lauro de Freitas|url=https://g1.globo.com/ba/bahia/noticia/2020/11/15/moema-gramacho-do-pt-e-reeleita-prefeita-de-lauro-de-freitas.ghtml|website=[[G1 (website)|G1]]|date=2020-11-15|access-date=2025-11-28|language=pt-br}}</ref>
